title: Harrington: aliens are real and he has seen them

tellings.quote: I can tell you this. Aliens are real. They're here and I've seen them
a couple drinks, he said, "All right, look, I can tell you this. Aliens are real. They're here and I've seen them."
tellings.difference: Puts the conversation on the veranda after drinks, places the home in the Washington DC area rather than Virginia, and ties it to the West Virginia briefing.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Brent Friedman relaying that, in 1981 at his home, Harrington told him aliens are real and that he had seen them.

as_told.title: Harrington tells Brent on the veranda that aliens are real
as_told.place_text: Harrington home, Washington DC area; briefing in an underground facility in West Virginia

related.note: Harrington himself tells about the same claimed 1981 conversation and denies it: he says he never said he saw aliens or was locked away.

plain: This story is about a private conversation in 1981 with a man named John Harrington. Brent Friedman, a guest on a podcast about Hollywood and UFOs, says that at Harrington's home, after a couple of drinks, Harrington told him: aliens are real, they are here, and he had seen them. In a later telling Friedman puts the talk on the veranda, places the home near Washington DC rather than in Virginia, and links it to a briefing in West Virginia. People tell it because, if true, it would mean someone with inside knowledge had confirmed alien visitors firsthand.
